entities.name: Jon
entities.description: One of the two speakers. A banker who lost his job on 19 January 2023 and spent the rest of 2023 trying to open his own dance studio. He has danced since childhood, names contemporary as his favourite style, danced with a crew that took first place in a local competition in 2022, and rehearsed with that group after work. He hunted for premises from January to June 2023, wanted a downtown space with natural light and Marley flooring, shut down his bank account in early April, read 'The Lean Startup', kept a colour-coded whiteboard of goals, set an official opening night for 20 June 2023, and by 21 July 2023 said the studio was on tenuous ground and he had taken a temporary job while looking for investors. Close friend of Gina, with whom he speaks every few weeks.

entities.name: Gina
entities.description: The other speaker. She lost her job at Door Dash in January 2023 and became an entrepreneur, running a clothing store: an ad campaign in January, a physical space she designed herself, a wholesaler secured on 1 February 2023, an online store she announced as open on 16 March 2023, promotions, a collaboration with a local artist, a limited edition line in June and a new ordering website in July. She was accepted for a part-time fashion internship on 27 May 2023 and was noticed by fashion editors in early July 2023. She danced competitively as a teenager, won a regional competition at fifteen with a contemporary piece called 'Finding Freedom', uses dance as stress relief, and has a tattoo standing for freedom. She is Jon's constant supporter.

entities.name: Jon's dance studio

properties.aliases: the studio; my dance studio; the dance studio; my biz; my business

entities.description: The dance studio Jon set out to found on 20 January 2023, the day after losing his banking job, and the subject of most of the conversation. Referred to throughout as 'the studio', 'my dance studio' and simply 'my biz'. Jon wanted it by the water, looked at a downtown space with good natural light, and insisted on Marley flooring with enough bounce. From February 2023 he spoke of already running it and of his students, while in the same months still searching for premises; the official opening night was set for 20 June 2023 and the conversation never says it took place. He expanded its social media, offered workshops to local schools, hosted a dance competition in May 2023, sought investors, and by 21 July 2023 described it as on tenuous ground.

entities.name: Gina's clothing store

properties.aliases: my store; my clothing store; my online clothing store; the online store; my online clothes store

entities.description: Gina's clothing business, started after she lost her job at Door Dash. The conversation refers to a physical store she advertised on 29 January 2023 and whose interior she designed herself, and to an online clothes store she announced as open on 16 March 2023 and again described in April as started 'not so long ago'; these mentions are joined here as one business because the dates, the stock and the customer base are described continuously. It sells trendy and unique fashion pieces plus dance-inspired items, sources from a wholesaler secured on 1 February 2023, has run offers and promotions, a collaboration with a local artist, a limited edition line made in June 2023 and a new ordering website built in July 2023.

entities.name: Door Dash
entities.description: Gina's former employer. She lost her job there in January 2023, which is what pushed her into starting her own clothing business; she was still describing the loss as the cause of tough times in March 2023.

entities.name: dancing
entities.description: The shared passion of both speakers and the thread running through the whole conversation. For Jon it has been a passion and an escape since childhood and is where he feels most alive; for Gina it is her stress relief and, as she puts it, like air. Both competed as young dancers, both name contemporary as their favourite style, and Jon's whole business is built on it.

entities.name: contemporary dance
entities.description: The dance style both Jon and Gina name as their favourite, on 20 January 2023. Jon calls it expressive and powerful; Gina calls it expressive and graceful. The piece her team won a regional competition with, 'Finding Freedom', was a contemporary piece, and Jon's crew covers contemporary among other styles.

entities.name: Jon's dance crew

properties.aliases: my dance crew; a small group of dancers

entities.description: The small group of dancers Jon rehearsed with after work, referred to as his dance crew and as 'a small group of dancers'. It took first place in a local competition in 2022, covers styles from contemporary to hip-hop, and was finishing choreography in January 2023 to perform at a nearby festival the following month, which it did before 8 February 2023.

entities.name: Jon's students

properties.aliases: my students; our young dancers; the dancers; aspiring dancers

entities.description: The group of dancers Jon teaches at his studio, named individually nowhere and returned to constantly. Jon speaks of them from February 2023 onwards, says he is learning alongside them, that seeing them progress is what motivates him, and that they include young dancers whose passion he finds inspiring. Besides classes and workshops he offers them one-on-one mentoring and training.

entities.name: Finding Freedom
entities.description: The contemporary dance piece Gina's team performed to win first place at a regional competition when she was fifteen. She described it on 20 January 2023 as really emotional and powerful, and it is her favourite dance memory.

entities.name: The Lean Startup
entities.description: The business book Jon was reading on 27 May 2023, hoping it would give him tips for his dance studio business. It got him thinking about building a focused and efficient business and about adapting from customer feedback.

entities.name: Paris
entities.description: The city Jon visited on 28 January 2023 and described as 'sooo cool'. Gina said on 29 January 2023 that she had never had a chance to visit it.

entities.name: Rome
entities.description: The city Gina said on 29 January 2023 she had visited once, and the destination of the short trip Jon took in the week before 19 June 2023 to clear his mind.

entities.name: Jon's whiteboard
entities.description: The whiteboard Jon uses to plan his business, showed Gina on 27 May 2023 covered in ideas, milestones and dates. It gives him a visual record of his progress; by 13 June 2023 he was colour-coding achievements on it to track progress and stay motivated.

entities.name: Gina's fashion internship

properties.aliases: the design internship; the fashion internship

entities.description: The part-time internship in the fashion department of an international company that Gina interviewed for on 10 May 2023, calling it a design internship, and was accepted for by 27 May 2023. She described herself as excited and nervous about what would be a big change.

entities.name: Shia LaBeouf
entities.description: The actor Gina named on 23 July 2023 as the source of the 'just do it' motivational speech she quoted at Jon; Jon agreed it was definitely him, and Gina repeated the line at the end of the conversation.
